exact_scope.additional_statistics: One train-only descriptive join of saved fine-step history residual/hidden energies with saved event available-target future RMSE; fixed highest ceil(25%) residual group and log1p Pearson correlation.

accepted_findings: All three saved NPZ and role JSON byte hashes match the exact immutable run-file bindings, without decoding arrays during review.
All local script and external TASK3 scoring-code hashes match the plan. The scorer is the same frozen implementation used for the original reports.
One atomic reservation in the common Git directory consumes the audit authority before array decoding; no retry or repeated role evaluation is available in this script.
The reader decodes each registered archive once, disallows pickle and extra members, and checks complete source-qualified roster order, shapes, lengths and saved truth finiteness.
Truth labels are checked against the original frozen fit-plan source rosters as well as the saved per-event classifications; no relabeling occurs.

Trajectory metrics, numerical qualification, every event classification, confusion matrices, unresolved coverage and role summaries are recomputed from saved truth and fine/refined predictions, then compared with the original JSON.
Train descriptive statistics use saved train JSON alone; val and test are excluded from the diagnosis. Missing/invalid joins and deterministic quartile tie handling are explicit.

The additional statistics contain arithmetic, percentiles, sorting and correlation only; they do not fit a model, solve dynamics, call gradients, perform matrix decomposition or reread original source payloads.
interpretation_boundaries: This is a separate replay of arithmetic on saved trajectories using the same frozen scoring implementation, not an independently implemented scoring algorithm.
Saved initialization energy and history residual values are summarized as recorded; the audit cannot independently reconstruct them from visible-only prediction arrays.
Association of history residual with future error does not identify a causal source of error. Available-target durations differ between events and can confound such an association.
No causal attribution, parameter or threshold tuning, model promotion, new real fit, or test-driven selection is authorized.
A subsequent known-truth discriminating experiment needs its own finite design, exact implementation review and scientific registration.
